report.summary: P-D004 (51M, Spanish, commercial PPO, no transport benefit, home tract 17031610300) screened positive for a transportation need but negative for utilities shutoff risk. No upcoming appointments requiring a transit feasibility check. Utilities: no active shutoff, so preventive/income-based bill help is appropriate. Transport: not eligible for Medicaid Ride Line (commercial insurance) or Senior Shuttle (age 51, under 60); paratransit only if ADA-qualifying disability. Tract has 4 nearby transit stops (3 early-service), so fixed-route bus/rail is a viable fallback.

options.name: Shutoff Prevention Clinic (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Walk-in Tuesdays for help with disconnection notices; no stated income restriction.

options.name: Neighborhood Energy Help (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Income-based help with gas/electric bills; apply in person Mon/Wed. Tract flagged low-income, so likely eligible.

options.name: Lakeside Energy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Helps with appointments and bills; requires identity verification (name, DOB, MRN) before enrollment. Commercial-insurance patient — confirm acceptance.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Apply for ADA paratransit certification by phone; decisions take up to 21 days. Only if patient has a qualifying disability.

options.name: Medicaid Ride Line (fictional)
options.how_to_access: For Medicaid plan members only; call the number on the card 2+ business days ahead. NOT eligible — patient has commercial insurance.

options.name: Senior Shuttle West (fictional)
options.how_to_access: Free weekday rides (7am–5pm) to medical appointments for adults 60+. NOT eligible — patient is 51.
